connector.name: Project Gutenberg MCP
connector.registryDescription: Read Project Gutenberg books via MCP. Search, fetch metadata, and retrieve text in passages.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image project-gutenberg-mcp:1.2.0. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the bobbyhouse account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: GUTENBERG_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL of your Gutenberg mirror. Run the mirror from the mirror/ directory and point this at it. See the README for setup instructions.

env.name: GUTENBERG_TOOLS
env.description: Comma-separated list of tools to expose. Available: search_books, get_book_metadata, fetch_book_text, list_passages, get_passage

env.name: GUTENBERG_BOOK_ID
env.description: Project Gutenberg book ID to use as the default for all tools. Find IDs via search_books. Example: 2680 for Meditations by Marcus Aurelius.

env.name: GUTENBERG_CHUNK_SIZE
env.description: Size in bytes of each passage returned by get_passage.

env.name: GUTENBERG_LANGUAGE
env.description: Default ISO 639-1 language code filter for search_books. Used when the caller omits the language parameter.
